notes.title: Major Update is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Flippers![/h2][p][/p][h3]First, we would like to apologize :([/h3][p]While working on adding controller and Steamdeck support, we ran into some complications and technical issues we weren’t able to resolve, so this update [b]won’t include[/b] it. Also, because of the delay with that, we weren’t able to finish the new layout options.[/p][p]We know you guys waited for those changes, and we’re very sorry we couldn’t add them this patch. But we’ll continue working on those, and hopefully will add them to the next one.[/p][p][/p][p]However, we did work on many other things (and thank god those worked out correctly :D)[/p][p][b]So here’s the list of everything new:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Achievements were added![/p][/*][*][p]You can now change your "home" bus[/p][/*][*][p]Added 7 new quests[/p][/*][*][p]Added completely new buses - Ural and Street Food[/p][/*][*][p]Ural is available at the Bus Sale[/p][/*][*][p]Added new collectibles[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell doors[/p][/*][*][p]You can now remove partitions[/p][/*][*][p]Added new items: furniture, hobs, showers, dakimakuras, cubes with letters[/p][/*][*][p]Some localization improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Better plumbing UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug when player has to put all the furniture again after reload[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with some objects movement possibility[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where finishes would flicker with a weird checkered texture instead of its own[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bugs with placing objects along a wall with different floor heights[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug with collectibles interaction button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where already mounted objects could not be snapped/placed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where facades would change their texture when switching materials[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where trims would appear in the shop when the player did not have the finishes tool[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where the final screen had too many tasks to fit on it[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone for sharing feedback, bugs, and just playing the game itself.[/p][p]We will continue to improve it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hope you enjoy the update![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update moved to Sept. 15th
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, flippers![/h3][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, we have to move the update from today to [b]15th of September[/b]. We strive to provide the best quality of features possible, so we need to move everything to a later date, to polish everything and give you the best version.
[/p][p][b]In the meantime, we’ll give you a list of what will be in this major update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]ACHIEVEMENTS![/p][/*][*][p]Most of the bugs that we learned about (thanks to our community) have been fixed. Thank you for that![/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to replace your home bus with a new one[/p][/*][*][p]Three new major quests and furniture sets — one in the good old Tokyo Bus, the second in Airstream, the third in URAL, as well as many simpler quests[/p][/*][*][p]New decor, taking into account player requests. You didn't ask for it, but we added dakimakura 🌚[/p][/*][*][p]New layout options in purchased buses. Open layouts are still a big problem for us, but we're trying to come up with something[/p][/*][*][p]You can now remove the partition you've installed[/p][/*][*][p]New collectibles have been added![/p][/*][*][p]Added cooking surfaces and new shower options[/p][/*][*][p]Added a set of letter cubes, you can compose various phrases and words[/p][/*][*][p]Control preset for SteamDeck
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for your support, and we hope you understand.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you on the 15th![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283412/192b38d305bea0be4787a3175ff135f4084bd979.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283412/0ac259b5a01632cb3649ac230a46d46553b2c3cc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 Development plans flipping forward
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, Flippers![/h1][h3]
Thanks everyone for jumping into Bus Flipper this early and for all the feedback and suggestions you leave! We are planning community-based development, so it helps us a ton.[/h3][p][/p][p]It's our first PC game, and it's so cool to see that you like our game, made by just 3 devs.
[/p][h3]What’s coming next:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Endless mode[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]For those who just want to relax and renovate. Will make buses on the market respawn, so you’ll never run out.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixing the majority of bugs[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We saw the bugs you reported with the floor staying after selling a bus, missing railings and not respawning buses. Will fix everything in the nearest update.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]If you want to help us improve:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Continue to post feedback and suggestions, we are listening! You can also do it [b][url="https://discord.gg/FCSXMCTc9j"]in Discord[/url].[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Share your cool (or cursed) builds, we love to see them, and they might spark some ideas.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Thanks again for riding with us, we appreciate you ❤️[/h3][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Bus Flipper Simulator — where old buses shine again
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Flippers![/h2][h3]
We wanted to make a little presentation about what’s waiting for you in the full release of the game, so here’s a rundown.[/h3][h3][/h3][p]Firstly, working on buses! You’ll be picking up trash, smashing stuff with a hammer, and wiping away dirt. You can also change surface finishes inside, add partitions, work on electricity and plumbing, and add all sorts of cool decorations. If you’re feeling [b]KOBY[/b] – play basketball with those trash bags and [b]earn money for best throws![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283412/9b899a1f1809f71d5fd402e39b776b20678dc9db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll get to complete [b]9 unique jobs[/b]. But if those jobs are about bringing someone else’s vision to life, buying an old rusty bus and fixing it up is [b]your chance to unleash your creativity[/b] [b]and make some serious cash.[/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283412/a0cc6fda513e410e2154819592f869fcb68553d1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]And how about going on a ride?[/b] The road to your clients might take you through some wild places. Driving mode lets you test your creations on the open road. [b]You can test drive all 6 unique buses.[/b][/p][p]
Keep your eyes peeled, and you might stumble across [b]collectible items[/b] or even [b]build a retro arcade machine to play on![/b] Level up your character and unlock new decorations for even more variety.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283412/35646278a2d95666e1d6857b392be0e024bbd074.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Bus Flipper Simulator is all about creativity, repair mechanics, and expressing yourself.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]And if you’re itching to fix up and sell smaller rides, [b]check out Car Dealer Simulator![/b] In that game, you buy, restore, and sell used cars, turning junk into gems. We’re thrilled to share that [b]our games are now available in a bundle[/b], so you can dive into the world of vehicle repair and trading with double the fun.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Playtest has started!
notes.content:
[h2]We're excited to announce that the playtest has begun, and you can now test the first version of the game![/h2]

[b]Here's what you can expect in this version:[/b]

- Two buses: Fleetwood Bounder 1986 and Nissan Diesel Spacerunne
- 4 missions
- Cleaning, breaking, building, buying and selling mechanics
- First sets of furniture

Please, note, that this is a very early version of the game, and mechanics could still change. Also, we'll add more furniture in the future.

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/FCSXMCTc9j]join our Discord[/url] to share your opinion or just chat :)
